description: This file defines a PHP trait `LDAPConnectionHelperTrait` within the `OrangeHRM\Tests\LDAP` namespace. The trait provides helper methods to check LDAP server configuration and retrieve configuration data, primarily interacting with a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: isLDAPServerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the LDAP server configuration file exists and is a real path, indicating the server is configured.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfig
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server configuration, parsing the YAML file if not already set.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the LDAP server configuration YAML file.
